messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 我目前無法即時查詢最新的網球排名。若您想知道目前世界排名第一的男子或女子網球選手，建議直接查看 ATP（男子）或 WTA（女子）的官方網站、App 或相關體育新聞平台，它們會在每週更新排名。若您需要其他協助，例如如何使用 API 取得排名資訊，我很樂意提供指導！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use function sports_team_standing? That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer with knowledge. But we don't have real-time data. We can say we don't have up-to-date info. We can provide general approach. Probably we should respond that we can't fetch real-time data.
